fit_type.doc: Fixed Count or Fit Length. Fit Curve is reserved and reports an error.

count.doc: Total number of copies, including the first.

fit_length.doc: Distance used to calculate copies in Fit Length mode.

relative_offset.doc: Per-axis multiple of the input geometry bounds.

constant_offset.doc: Fixed translation added to each step.

merge_vertices.doc: Weld adjacent copies and touching caps within Merge Distance.

merge_distance.doc: Maximum distance for welding. Zero disables welding for legacy graph compatibility.

merge_first_last.doc: Also weld the last regular copy with the first.

uv_offset_u.doc: Shift U on each regular copy.

uv_offset_v.doc: Shift V on each regular copy.
